failure_modes.detection: None locally; only visible as missing validations on the network.
failure_modes.mechanism: Seed path sets sequence 0; peers already cached sequence 3; rebuilt manifest is stale and validations are ignored.
failure_modes.name: Sequence reset after seed-only restore

failure_modes.mechanism: An old backup restored after a rotation carries a lower sequence than the one peers cached; it is stale.
failure_modes.name: Stale token restored after rotation

failure_modes.detection: Only discovered at the next rotation or compromise, when the master key is needed.
failure_modes.mechanism: Validation resumes from the token, but rotation and revocation need the master key, which is gone.
failure_modes.name: Token-only backup masquerades as full recovery

failure_modes.detection: Obvious at rebuild time (no key material), but unfixable.
failure_modes.mechanism: No master key means no new token, no revocation, no domain update; the identity is unrecoverable.
failure_modes.name: Master-key loss with no backup

failure_modes.detection: None locally; node is up but does not validate.
failure_modes.mechanism: Deploy wipes the config volume, then injects the token; a failed injection leaves a valid config with no validator keys.
failure_modes.name: Tokenless config after failed injection

failure_modes.detection: None locally; missing validations on the network.
failure_modes.mechanism: Recovered validator's key is absent from peers' trusted lists, so its validations are ignored.
failure_modes.name: Wrong UNL after rebuild

failure_modes.detection: Visible as a long sync; duration is UNTESTABLE in the lab.
failure_modes.mechanism: A snapshot whose hash matches no validated ledger cannot seed the node database; full re-sync is required.
failure_modes.name: Ledger snapshot unusable

model_conventions.lab_keys: fixed test secrets derived from SHA-256 of labelled strings; never real keys
model_conventions.manifest: canonical string master|signing|sequence|domain, signed by master and signing secp256k1 keys (RFC 6979 nonces)
model_conventions.node_id: first 20 bytes of SHA-512 over the compressed public key (model convention; pinned source establishes nodeID = calcNodeID(masterKey) deterministically)
model_conventions.peer_cache: manifest with sequence <= cached sequence is stale (Manifest.cpp:411); sequence 0xFFFFFFFF revokes (Manifest.cpp:240)
model_conventions.unl: validator trusted iff its master public key is listed by a configured trusted publisher
